headline: been playing with @typesafeai's Jev and built a fragrance finder

media.alt: Video from the post by Martin

text:
been playing with @typesafeai's Jev and built a fragrance finder

no notes or accords, just describe what you want in plain english

"sunset aperitivo on the Amalfi coast, linen shirt, a bit of salt in the air" → Acqua di Giò, 95%

turns out it's pretty good at picking perfume
